name: Tenshi
source:
Honor student at Central High School.

He is also the leader of "Central Dogma" and has a certain arcade.

He's a kid who views everyone other than himself as "lesser than," and he seems to be on a high horse no matter what he does.

"At best, do your best for me?"

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22703015]official website[/url]]
